growth.text: Won revenue rose from 2,660,250 in 2025 Q3 to 3,310,350 in 2025 Q4 (+650,100, +24.4%). 89 won deals in 2025 Q4 (106 in 2025 Q3), at an average of 37,195 (25,097 in 2025 Q3): the number of deals accounts for −426,644 and the average deal size for +1,076,744, which add up to the change. The growth came from bigger deals.

cycle.text: The median sales cycle of won deals (days from created to close) was 50 days in 2025 Q4 against 34 days in 2025 Q3 (+16 days); the mean was 55.2 days against 39.9 days.

pipeline.text: On the export date (2026-01-05), 85 deals were open, worth 3,096,000 (1,040,165 weighted by probability). 12 deals are past their expected close date and 8 others had no stage change for more than 30 days; together 756,000 (24.4% of the open value). 41 open deals are expected to close in 2026 Q1: 1,326,850 (407,335 weighted). Give a target in the card to see coverage.

reps.note: Reps are shown as Rep A, B and C (ranked by won revenue): the owner column was coded at the personal-data step.

change.subject: SMB
change.title: SMB won revenue −93,400 (344,900 to 251,500)
change.text: SMB won revenue fell from 344,900 in 2025 Q3 to 251,500 in 2025 Q4 (−93,400); the data shows it came from fewer deals: the average won deal went from 5,748 to 5,716 (deal size −1,427) and won deals from 60 to 44 (deal count −91,973); why the deals changed in number: driver to be confirmed.

summary.headline: Won revenue was 3,310,350 in 2025 Q4, up on 2025 Q3 (+650,100, +24.4%). The growth came from bigger deals: 89 won deals (106 in 2025 Q3) at an average of 37,195 (25,097); the average deal size accounts for +1,076,744 and the number of deals for −426,644.
lines: By segment, Enterprise grew most (1,486,750 to 2,192,700, +705,950), from bigger deals (average 92,922 to 137,044); Enterprise win rate 42.1% to 43.2%; Mid-Market win rate 36.6% to 36.2%; SMB win rate 38.0% to 22.0%.
Sales cycle: median 50 days in 2025 Q4 against 34 days in 2025 Q3.
Pipeline on 2026-01-05: 85 deals open, 3,096,000 (1,040,165 weighted); 20 deals stalled (24.4% of its value).
Top reps by won revenue in 2025 Q4: Rep A 1,191,250 (9 deals, win rate 52.9%); Rep B 1,080,750 (15 deals, win rate 57.7%); Rep C 324,400 (8 deals, win rate 23.5%).
change: 24.4% of the open pipeline is stalled

notes: Quarters are calendar quarters; 2025 Q4 runs 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31 and 2025 Q3 runs 2025-07-01 to 2025-09-30. A deal is in the quarter its close date falls in.
Won revenue is the sum of the amounts of the deals won in the quarter. The win rate is won / (won + lost) of the deals closed in the quarter; open deals are not in it.

The change in won revenue is split into the number of won deals (at the quarter before's average deal) and the average deal size (at this quarter's number of deals); the two parts add up to the change exactly.
The pipeline is the open deals (neither won nor lost) on the export date, 2026-01-05.
No figure rests on fewer than 5 deals: such a figure is shown as “<5”.
